name: LinkedIn: Posts
summary: Return up to 20 recent posts of one LinkedIn person or company as rzn.items/v2.
description: Open one LinkedIn person's activity list or one company's Posts tab in the user's signed-in Chrome, as a person would, and return up to 20 of the account's own posts as rzn.item/v2 items (reposts of other people's posts are left out). Use to index what an account posts on LinkedIn.

account.description: in/<profile slug> for a person or company/<company slug> for a company, e.g. in/satyanadella or company/microsoft.

output_schema.description: rzn.items/v2 page (schema/rzn.items.v2.json): one rzn.item/v2 per post, key linkedin:post:<id>.

help.summary: Return up to 20 recent posts of one LinkedIn person or company as rzn.items/v2.
returns: rzn.items/v2 page, listing feed, next_cursor null (one page per run): key linkedin:post:<id> (the id of the post's own urn:li:activity|share|ugcPost link; the activity id where the page shows one), kind post, url /feed/update/urn:li:<type>:<id>/, author (name, id = profile or company slug, url), published_at (RFC 3339, from the id's time bits), published_in LinkedIn, marker text:<hash of the text>, counts reactions/comments/reposts; one post block (the whole text) plus a quoted block when the post quotes another. truncated is set when the text stayed collapsed; such an item is not indexed.
notes: Requires a signed-in LinkedIn session; read-only.
Makes no request of its own: it opens the account's page, then its activity or Posts tab, scrolls the list and clicks '… more' as a person would, and reads what LinkedIn rendered.

steps.name: Open the person's or company's page
Go to the activity list (person) or the Posts tab (company)
Wait until the activity list or Posts tab has loaded
Scroll the list, open collapsed texts and map each post the page shows
